name: @art-pollinator/blob-store-filesystem
description: FilesystemBlobStorePort — a BlobStorePort implementation backed by the local filesystem (issue #40), content-addressed by the same SHA-256 core already uses for MetadataToken content hashes. Verifies integrity on fetch and rejects a mismatch. Also ships a JSON-file-backed BlobFetchQueueStorePort for the deferred blob queue (issue #41).
